info.title: Softmax AIDE interface
info.description: Public contract owned by softmax.com. This document describes the relay: send/receive are from its viewpoint. Both connections expose the same logical interface; backend frames add authenticated frontend routing. Download protocol.md for behavioral requirements. Publication does not activate a relay or certify an implementation.

frontend.title: Frontend connection
frontend.description: Authenticated workspace owner. Bare JSON-RPC application frames. Endpoint is relative to the platform API base URL.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier bound by authenticated transport. Never authorization by itself.

backend.title: AIDE backend connection
backend.description: Authenticated workspace bridge. Application frames wrap JSON-RPC as {frontend_id,message}. Endpoint is relative to the platform API base URL.

revision.description: Durable revision of this record: the workspace store sequence of its latest change. Larger is newer; it survives backend restarts.

requests.description: Up to 1000 non-terminal requests of this session plus its 10 most recently updated terminal ones, ordered by created_at, oldest first, without messages. active_request_ids lists every non-terminal request, so it can name requests this list omits; read state.list requests for the rest.

revision.description: Durable revision of this record: the workspace store sequence of its latest change. Larger is newer; it survives backend restarts.
Durable revision of this record: the workspace store sequence of its latest change. Larger is newer; it survives backend restarts.

kind.description: message: conversation content. continuation: a user-role prompt written to continue an earlier request, such as AIDE's resume prompt after a hold; not typed by the user. failed_turn: an assistant-role runtime notice about a failed turn that the request record already reports. Frontends normally hide continuation and failed_turn. Absent means message.

reasoning.description: The model's retained reasoning for an assistant message.

ErrorClass.description: Open classification of a model-work failure. Documented values: budget_exhausted, rate_limited, provider_unavailable (these pass on their own: the request waits and resumes), too_large (the conversation no longer fits), misconfigured (the workspace's model setup is broken). Treat unknown values as a generic failure.

Cursor.description: Position in a request's progress. attempt counts the request's durable resumes (0 for its first run); seq is the run's own event sequence. Cursors order by attempt, then seq; {attempt:n, seq:0} is the start of attempt n.

RequestWaiting.description: Why a waiting request is held and when AIDE resumes it. Do not read the request before until; after it, one read wakes the workspace.

until.description: Earliest resume time. A budget hold can last past it, until new budget arrives.

RequestError.description: Why a request failed. code is a stable identifier; message is human-readable detail and is not parsed; class is the classified cause when known.

code.description: Stable identifier, for example the class or interrupted.

ChatRequest.description: Durable record of one unit of chat work in a session: a chat.send, or work AIDE started itself. Read it as resource requests; sessions embed their recent ones.

request_id.description: The chat.send request ID, or a UUID AIDE chose for runtime work. chat.cancel and chat.events take it.

origin.description: user: a chat.send. runtime: work AIDE started without one, such as a continuation or wake run. Both can be cancelled and can hold pending inputs.

status.description: queued until work starts, then running. waiting: held after a budget, rate-limit or provider failure; AIDE resumes it without the frontend; never resend it. Terminal: completed, cancelled, failed, interrupted (a workspace restart or crash stopped it; some actions may have run).

created_at.description: Session.requests is ordered by created_at, oldest first; state.list requests newest first.

revision.description: Durable revision of this record: the workspace store sequence of its latest change. Larger is newer; it survives backend restarts.

attempt.description: The current attempt: read chat.events from {attempt, seq:0} when no newer cursor is known.

in_history.description: Whether chat.history holds this request's messages. False before work starts and after a request ends without starting; read the request for its messages.

error.description: Non-null exactly when status is failed or interrupted.

waiting.description: Non-null exactly when status is waiting.

messages.description: The chat.send messages. Only state.get returns them, and only while in_history is false. A retry resends them under a new request ID.

message_omitted.description: Replaces messages when they would not fit the message limit.

ChatEvent.description: One progress event of a chat request at cursor {attempt, seq}. seq starts at 1 in each attempt and increases by exactly one per event; events the runtime cannot place are folded into the next event or dropped before seq is assigned. chat.events reads these events and chat.event pushes the same events with the same cursors.

oneOf.description: Interim assistant text between tool calls. already_streamed: text.delta events already carried it.

truncated.description: text was cut to fit the message limit.

oneOf.description: The model is reasoning; text when the model exposes it.

truncated.description: text was cut to fit the message limit.

oneOf.description: A backend tool call started. It never asks the frontend to run anything.

arguments.description: The call arguments as JSON text.

truncated.description: arguments was cut to fit the message limit and is not valid JSON; display only.

oneOf.description: A backend tool call finished; its result is in chat.history.
The request's terminal outcome. Always its last event.

Client.description: The frontend that opened a session (legacy parity). AIDE stamps it into every turn of that session.

id.description: Stable frontend identity, for example a site or product id.

guide.description: Name of the agent guide skill for this frontend.

context.description: Runtime-defined turn context (for example the page the user is looking at), passed to the workspace unchanged. The workspace validates and renders it; the platform does not interpret it.

instructions.description: Per-request guidance for the agent, kept out of the visible message; passed to the workspace unchanged.

wake.description: false: never wake a sleeping workspace for this read; the relay refuses it with asleep and outcome not_delivered instead. Default true.

session_id.description: Required for, and only valid with, resource requests.

wake.description: false: never wake a sleeping workspace for this read; the relay refuses it with asleep and outcome not_delivered instead. Default true.

cursor.description: Opaque, stable boundary from next_cursor: records older than the last page's oldest record. It stays valid as new messages arrive.

after_sequence.description: Read forward: records with a greater sequence, oldest first. Excludes cursor.

wake.description: false: never wake a sleeping workspace for this read; the relay refuses it with asleep and outcome not_delivered instead. Default true.

after.description: Return events after this cursor; {attempt:0, seq:0} reads from the start.

wake.description: false: never wake a sleeping workspace for this read; the relay refuses it with asleep and outcome not_delivered instead. Default true.

next.description: The last returned event's cursor, or after when none were returned. Pass it as the next after.

done.description: True when the request is terminal and no event follows next.

cursor.description: The cursor of the text.delta event this chunk mirrors. Requires request_id.

revision.description: The request record's revision after it finished.
The request record's revision after it finished.

reason.description: inference_unavailable only. Null while model access is being renewed.

until.description: inference_unavailable only. When model work may start again; null when unknown.

aide_presenceMessage.description: Relay-owned: the workspace backend connected (present:true) or went away (present:false). On either, read every open request's record and its events from the last applied cursor. Peers never send it.

related_uploads.description: Other uploads of the viewed Coworld, for grouping.
